message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, APIs, and platforms) you can use to book flights, whether you’re a traveler, a developer building a travel app, or a travel agent looking for integration options.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers | Typical use‑case |
|----------|----------------|----------------|-----------------|
| **Consumer flight‑search & booking sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price alerts, multi‑city itineraries | Quick personal booking, price comparison |
| | **Skyscanner** | Aggregates fares from many airlines & OTAs | Personal booking, price alerts, multi‑stop search |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates fares, offers “Price Forecast” | Personal booking, price alerts |
| | **Expedia** | Full travel package (flights + hotels + car) | Personal booking, bundled deals |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” & “Express Deals” | Personal booking, last‑minute deals |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, often used by corporate travelers | Personal booking, corporate travel |
| | **Momondo** | Aggregates fares, shows price trends | Personal booking, price comparison |
| | **CheapOair** | Direct airline booking, often with promo codes | Personal booking, promo‑code deals |
| | **Travelocity** | Similar to Expedia/Orbitz | Personal booking, bundled deals |
| | **Hotwire** | “Hot Rate” deals, often cheaper | Personal booking, last‑minute deals |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** (for flight‑related experiences) | Not a flight booking tool, but useful for travel planning | Personal booking, experiential travel |
| **Airline‑direct booking portals** | **Delta, United, American, Southwest, etc.** | Direct booking, loyalty points | Personal booking, frequent flyer benefits |
| **Corporate & B2B travel platforms** | **Concur** | Expense & travel management | Corporate travel, expense reporting |
| | **Egencia** | Corporate travel booking & reporting | Corporate travel, policy compliance |
| | **SAP Ariba Travel** | Enterprise travel procurement | Corporate travel, procurement |
| | **TravelPerk** | Modern corporate travel platform | Corporate travel, expense integration |
| **Travel‑agency & OTA APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, availability, pricing | Build travel apps, integrate flight booking |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Flight search, booking, inventory, GDS integration | Build travel apps, integrate with GDS |
| | **Travelport APIs** | Flight, hotel, car, package booking | Build travel apps, integrate with GDS |
| | **Expedia Affiliate Network** | Flight, hotel, car, package APIs | Build travel apps, earn commissions |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Flight search, price alerts, multi‑city | Build travel apps, price comparison |
| | **Kayak API** | Flight search, price alerts | Build travel apps, price comparison |
| | **Priceline Partner Network** | Flight, hotel, car APIs | Build travel apps, earn commissions |
| | **Google Flights API** (via Google Travel Partner Program) | Flight search, price alerts | Build travel apps, price comparison |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (not booking) | Flight tracking, analytics |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status | Tracking, analytics |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data | Tracking, analytics |
| **Scraping & automation tools** | **BeautifulSoup + Selenium** | Scrape flight data from sites | Data mining, price monitoring |
| | **Scrapy** | Web crawling framework | Large‑scale data extraction |
| | **Apify** | Cloud‑based web scraping & automation | Automated flight data collection |
| | **Octoparse** | Visual web scraper | Non‑coding flight data extraction |
| | **ParseHub** | Visual web scraper | Non‑coding flight data extraction |
| **Voice & chatbot assistants** | **Amazon Alexa Skills** (e.g., “Alexa, book a flight”) | Voice‑controlled flight booking | Voice‑enabled travel planning |
| | **Google Assistant Actions** | Voice‑controlled flight booking | Voice‑enabled travel planning |
| | **Chatbot platforms** (Dialogflow, Rasa) | Build flight‑booking chatbots | Customer support, self‑service |
| **Travel‑price‑comparison & aggregator APIs** | **Google Travel Partner Program** | Access to flight data for comparison | Build price‑comparison tools |
| | **Travelpayouts** | Affiliate flight booking API | Earn commissions on bookings |
| | **Skiplagged API** | Hidden‑city flight search | Price comparison, hidden‑city deals |
| | **Hopper API** | Predictive pricing, price alerts | Price prediction, alerts |
| | **Airfarewatchdog API** | Price alerts, deals | Price alerts, deals |
| **Travel‑management SaaS** | **TripActions** | Corporate travel, expense, booking | Corporate travel, expense integration |
| | **CWT (Carlson Wagonlit Travel)** | Corporate travel, booking | Corporate travel, policy compliance |
| | **Concur Travel** | Corporate travel, booking | Corporate travel, expense integration |

### How to choose the right tool

| Need | Recommended tool(s) |
|------|--------------------|
| **Personal booking, quick comparison** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak |
| **Last‑minute or discounted deals** | Hotwire, Priceline, Momondo |
| **Corporate travel & expense integration** | Concur, Egencia, TravelPerk |
| **Developing a travel app** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, Skyscanner API |
| **Affiliate marketing** | Expedia Affiliate Network, Priceline Partner Network, Travelpayouts |
| **Flight status & tracking** | FlightAware, FlightStats, OpenSky |
| **Automated price monitoring** | BeautifulSoup/Selenium, Scrapy, Octoparse |
| **Voice‑enabled booking** | Alexa Skills, Google Assistant Actions |

---

#### Quick Tips

1. **API vs. Website** – If you’re a developer, start with the official APIs (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). If you’re just booking for yourself, the consumer sites are usually easier.
2. **Data Accuracy** – GDS‑based APIs (Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport) pull real‑time inventory from airlines, so they’re the most accurate for booking.
3. **Cost** – Many APIs charge per request or per user. For small projects, free tiers (e.g., Skyscanner, Amadeus sandbox) are a good start.
4. **Compliance** – When integrating with airline booking, you’ll need to comply with airline and GDS rules (e.g., fare rules, taxes, seat inventory).
5. **User Experience** – For consumer sites, consider adding price alerts or multi‑city search to improve UX.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any specific platform, or if you’re looking for code snippets to get started with a particular API!
